title: CNLU National Article Writing Competition 2026
summary: Write a legal article for the Centre for Legal Education at Chanakya National Law University, Patna; top entries join a virtual panel discussion.
eligibility: UG and PG law students at recognised Indian institutions; solo or two co-authors (cross-institution allowed).

prize.description: ₹45,000 total: ₹20,000, ₹15,000 and ₹10,000, each with an internship opportunity.

notes: Article submission closes 30 November 2026; results 10 January 2027.
